name: Red air: FPV 7-inch OWA (G1)
description: Racing-style FPV one-way-attack quad, 1-2 kg payload. Terrain-masked ingress at 10-100 ft AGL; terminal dive.

maxTurnRateDegS.note: Planning factor: the flight-path turn rate a multirotor can hold at its cruise speed is g tan(tilt) / V. A Betaflight FPV quad has no tilt cap; the PX4 MPC_TILTMAX_AIR default of 45° is used as the sustained-turn tilt. At the record's cruise speed 25 m/s: 9.8 / 25 rad/s = 22°/s. The body yaw-rate cap (DJI publishes 100 to 300°/s; PX4 MC_YAWRATE_MAX 200°/s) is not a path turn limit and is not used.

climbRateMps.note: Planning factor: no vendor publishes a climb rate for a 7-inch strike quad (Blue Bird Zhakh 7 and InsideFPV Kamikaze give only 120 and 150+ km/h top speeds). A 2 kg build with thrust-to-weight near 2 can climb at a full g; 10 m/s is taken as the sustained climb with payload.

maxAccelMps2.note: Planning factor: a multirotor's horizontal acceleration is g tan(tilt). A Betaflight FPV quad has no tilt cap; the PX4 MPC_TILTMAX_AIR default of 45° is used. 9.81 × tan 45° = 9.8 m/s².

radiatedPowerW.note: Planning factor: no single vendor figure exists for a class airframe. The analog 5.8 GHz video transmitter is the strongest emitter: a documented combat build carries an AKK Race Ranger 1.6 W VTX (github.com/wvrld/fpv-combat-drone); long-range VTX tiers run 0.8 to 1.6 W with 2.5 W units available (rslfpv.com; Rush Tank Max Solo). The ELRS 900 MHz airborne receiver radiates 10 to 500 mW of telemetry (oscarliang.com); the 1 W ELRS transmitter is on the ground.

attributes.emissionsNote: Analog 5.8 GHz video, ELRS 900 MHz control
attributes.rangeNote: Strikes 5-15 km; relay drones and high-gain video links push 20-30 km. Extended packs and wing kits reported.

threatProfile.routeIntent: Terrain-masked attack along roads and treelines, 3-8 km launch

linkProtocol.source: Documented combat build (ELRS 915 MHz Nano receiver, RadioMaster Bandit ELRS 915 MHz, analog 5.8 GHz video; github.com/wvrld/fpv-combat-drone) and Blue Bird Zhakh 7 product page (ELRS 400 to 960 MHz control, analog 4.9 to 6.1 GHz video)
linkProtocol.note: Control link ELRS at 900 MHz; the video link is analog 5.8 GHz FPV.
